rationale: The papers 'Bayesian Analysis of Quasi-periodic Pulsations in Stellar Flares', 'Statistical Study of GOES X-ray Quasi-Periodic Pulsations in Solar Flares', and 'Feature Identification and Statistical Characteristics of Quasi-periodic Pulsation in Solar Flares using the Markov-Chain-Monte-Carlo Approach' contribute substantive new evidence on the detection and characterization of QPPs, addressing factors such as noise and model comparison, but do not fully settle the debate.
